lines.text: The LORD tells Moses to have the Israelites bring pure oil of pressed olives to keep the lamps burning continually.
Aaron tends the lamps on the pure gold lampstand before the LORD from evening until morning.
Twelve loaves of fine flour are set in two rows of six on the bronze altar.
Frankincense is placed near each row, and the bread is set out every Sabbath day on behalf of the foreigners.
The bread belongs to Aaron and his sons, who are to eat it in a holy place.
